speaker: John Dugenske
title: Chief Investment Officer at Allstate Corporation
msg: For example, in 2022, the property liability combined ratio was elevated, and both macroeconomic and market dynamics were unfavorable. speaker: John Dugenske
title: Chief Investment Officer at Allstate Corporation
